title: Giants' Braxton Berrios to undergo season-ending foot surgery

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Giants' Braxton Berrios to undergo season-ending foot surgery
sources.description: After being placed on injured reserve following a foot injury he suffered against the Arizona Cardinals in Week 4, Giants wide receiver and kick/punt returner Braxton Berrios will undergo surgery that will end his 2026-27 season.
